description: Per-email and per-sequence rubric for the 7-email Bassam-led Summer of Skills non-payer sequence. Two layers: machine_checks run by scripts/eval_runner.py (deterministic regex, hard stops), llm_checks judged by the reviewing agent (pass/fail plus a 1-5 quality score). The rubric is the pre-gate self-check loop; it does not replace the formal gate stack (arabic-copy-qa, english-copy-qa, email-asset-qa, accessibility-qa, compliance-privacy-check, brand-qa-reviewer, human gate).

machine_checks.fix: Remove the em dash or en dash. Use a comma, colon, or period.
Replace Eastern Arabic numerals with Western numerals 0-9.
Remove the exclamation mark. Confidence comes from the claim, not the punctuation.
Each sale email (E5-E7) must carry the placeholder code SUM30 in its own PromoLine slot (held until confirmed).
Every unconfirmed sale term (percentage, code, date) must be flagged PLACEHOLDER, HELD until the human gate confirms it.

per_email.description: The email serves its act objective (E1-E2 Bassam hook, E3-E4 platform/self-development, E5-E7 sale announce/ending/last-day).
Exactly one CTA, and it serves the objective (a play or a subscribe step), not opens.
Subject 20-60 chars, mobile band 30-40, front-loaded, no percentage and no 'last chance' phrase in the subject, true to the body.
Preheader 40-90 chars, adds a layer (does not repeat the subject); for E5-E7 it carries the calm dated deadline.
Empowering, never deficit-framed; premium, not hype or spam; no stacked urgency.
Only cleared Bassam facts (authority line, 20 lessons, free first lesson); only the three cleared instructors named in E3; no invented lessons/counts/quotes/awards/client names; no accreditation.
E5-E7 only: PromoLine carries SUM30 and a calm dated deadline; urgency reads premium; all sale values flagged HELD; no false scarcity.
CTA points to the right place: class page (E1-E2), classes page (E3), plans page (E4-E7), language-matched /ar or /en.

per_sequence.description: Clean 2/2/3 arc with distinct act transitions and no repetition of the same value across emails.
Urgency rises only in Act 3 and only by degree: E5 announce, E6 ending tomorrow, E7 last day. Bodies shorten toward E7.
AR and EN carry the same promise, offer, and claims per email; language-appropriate gendered address is allowed and is not a divergence.
One consistent Maharat voice across all 14 variants; Thmanyah tone; brand lexicon.
Cadence and suppression are defined upstream, and every sale term and date is flagged as an open item for the gate.

llm_checks.loop: Author -> score. Any machine_checks hard fail, any per-email pass-fail = fail, or any 1-5 score < 4 returns an exact fix list to the author and re-scores. Advance to the formal gate stack only when all checks pass.
